circumference_measurements.name: chest_circumference
circumference_measurements.definition: Horizontal transverse perimeter at mesosternale level (Y=+0.090m, 65% trunk height).
circumference_measurements.notes: Corrected slicing level from shoulder line down to true thoracic ribcage.

circumference_measurements.name: waist_circumference
circumference_measurements.definition: Horizontal transverse perimeter at narrowest lumbar / omphalion level (Y=-0.023m, 42% trunk height).
circumference_measurements.notes: Corrected slicing level from neck/upper arms (which yielded 1402 mm) down to true natural waist.

circumference_measurements.name: hip_circumference
circumference_measurements.definition: Horizontal transverse perimeter at maximum gluteal / pelvic crest level (Y=-0.155m, 15% trunk height).
circumference_measurements.notes: Corrected slicing level from chin/jaw (which yielded 1261 mm) down to true pelvic hip crest.

circumference_measurements.name: head_circumference
circumference_measurements.definition: Horizontal transverse perimeter passing through supraorbital ridge (Y=+0.722m, 70 mm below crown).
circumference_measurements.notes: Superior cranium was outside vertical camera field-of-view; derived from fitted template prior.

arm_exclusion_algorithm: Trunk midline loop selection enclosing X=0 in horizontal plane
contour_closure_algorithm: Explicit closure validation (is_contour_closed: gap ratio <= 1.8, isoperimetric circularity >= 0.10)
